content: आनन्दः [आनन्द्-घञ्] .²1 Happiness, joy, delight, pleasure; आनन्दं ब्रह्मणो विद्वान्न बिभेति कदाचन <ls>T. Up.</ls> supreme bliss or felicity; आनन्द एवास्य विज्ञानमात्मानन्दात्मनो हैवं सर्वे देवाः <ls>Śat. Br.</ls> .²2 God, Supreme Spirit (ब्रह्मन्) (said to be {%n.%} also in this sense; <ab>cf.</ab> विज्ञानमानन्दं ब्रह्म <ls>Bṛ. Up. 3. 9. 28.</ls>). .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of the forty-eighth year of the cycle of Jupiter. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of Balarāma (according to Jaina doctrines). .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of a cousin and follower and favourite disciple of Buddha Śākyamuni, compiler of the Sūtras. .²8 A variety of the Daṇḍaka metre. .{@-दा, -दी@} <ab>N.</ab> of two plants (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>भाङ्ग, रानमोगरी</ns>). .{@-दम्@} .²1 Wine, liquor. .²2 A kind of house.
